method: Preserve original independently authored source/output passes and disagreements; exact native/source/pointer/byte crosswalks; bounded source-read semantic comparisons and literal/hash validation. No majority-vote or raw-count proxy for meaning.

conclusion: The final bounded source/model/downstream account is supplied with no pending inputs in its declared scope. Original64 C source-case objects, independent author attributions, disagreements and raw runtime provenance are preserved. Useful partial local attachments, a theorem application, a definition-location reference, selected table/caption lineages and supported-facet display survive despite wrong subjects/roles, truncated terms, formula corruption, lost conditions and unassessed relations. All97 raw envelopes remain available; their successful parsing/task completion does not establish meaning. Actual dossier greedy displays four role facets of two previously supported attachments versus zero under deterministic source-ID control, without new source facts. Broad812-record capture, most provider fields/pairs, graphical fidelity, scientific truth, calibration and whole-corpus recall/precision remain unestablished. This partial semantic account is separate from complete selected software/consumer qualification.
